**Mechanism -> implication -> recommendation across data sources.**

Vorburger's profile exemplifies a typical Swiss astrophysics career arc: ETH-trained engineer (2008) -> PhD in planetary physics at Unibe (2013, mass spectrometry-focused) -> US postdoc at AMNH (2013-2015) -> long Unibe postdoc period (2015-2022) -> Adjunct Lecturer (2022-2024) -> Assistant Professor (2024-today) with an SNSF Starting Grant (Sept 2024 - Aug 2029). The grant is the inflection point: it converts her into an independent PI with her own ~1.5M CHF budget, allowing her to stand up a new research group (consistent with the snippet "with her new research group, Dr. Vorburger will model plumes on Europa"). The group's central activity aligns tightly with two flagship planetary missions (JUICE, Europa Clipper), of which both have instrument leads at Unibe (PEP and MASPEX respectively). This creates a multi-axis alignment: scientific mission + PI-level funding + group-leader status + Bern institutional scale advantage.

| Comparison Axis | Before grant (2014-2024) | With grant (2024-2029) |
|---|---|---|
| Funding role | Employed on Wurz/Thomas SNSF projects | Sole-named PI on her own SNSF Starting Grant |
| Mission role | Co-I or Co-PI on multiple missions | Continues JUICE/PEP, Europa Clipper/MASPEX experience now anchored by her independent group |
| Teaching role | Adjunct Lecturer (2022-2024) | Ass. Prof. (from 2024) |
| Group status | Member of Wurz's team | Independent group leader |
| Brag score (external visibility) | "PD Dr." in news snippets | "Ass. Prof. Dr." in Unibe senior staff and SNSF portal |
| Funding body | SNSF (employer) | SNSF (as competitive PI) |

**Tension: hired vs PI mismatch.** The SNSF portal lists several older projects with Vorburger under "Anstellung" (employed) on Wurz-led and Thomas-led SNSF grants; she was a contributor to those projects but not a budget holder. Treating those as part of her "funding portfolio" would over-state her grant-management role. Implication: when reporting her grants, list only "Plumes" under PI; the Wurz/Thomas grants belong to those PIs.

**Tension: open positions vs group attribution gap.** Several WP-division postings are open, but none explicitly name Vorburger as the supervisor in the URL or the page list. Implication: candidates should not assume these are necessarily her group's openings; an interested candidate should follow the named PI in the full posting text - likely Alibert (NCCR PlanetS, formation models), Marschall/Jutzi (asteroids), Mordasini/Osborn (exoplanet atmospheres), or Demory/Kuhn (instrumentation), based on WP Senior Staff discipline match.

**Tension: announcement count - 9 vs 11 SNSF Starting Grants at Bern.** The Unibe 2025 official media release reports 9 Bern recipients of SNSF Starting Grants 2025 totalling over 15M CHF. A cached WP snippet mentions "11 SNSF Starting Grant recipients at the University of Bern" and "PD Dr." (older title). The mismatch most plausibly refers to a subsequent reporting period or an admin draft; the official 2025 release's count of 9 is more authoritative for the 2025 call. Implication: cite the official Unibe media release and SNSF data portal over the WP admin-URL snippet.

**Mechanism: how the grant enables the new group.** A typical SNSF Starting Grant at this tier (1.5M CHF) supports PI salary, postdocs, PhDs, equipment, and operations over 4-5 years. The grant is explicitly "to carry out their own research project and lead a research team in Switzerland" per the Unibe release. Implication: under this grant Vorburger can plausibly hire a PhD or postdoc, but until a specific job.ad specifies funding source, do not attribute it to her grant.
content.recommendations:
- **For funding/outreach team**: Cite the SNSF Plumes Starting Grant as her single most relevant recent competitive funding. Cite the SNSF data portal URL as the primary source and the Unibe media release as institutional corroboration. Do not over-attribute older Wurz or Thomas grants to her.
- **For hiring team**: When a candidate asks "Is there an open position in Vorburger's group?", answer with division-level information first (6 WP openings at jobs.unibe.ch), then caveat that none of the indexed URLs name her as the named PI/supervisor; resolution requires visiting each posting text directly.
- **For PI/co-PI verification**: Search CORDIS, ERC, NASA/SSERVI, ESA osse databases for PI/co-PI attribution on Europa Clipper MASPEX or JUICE PEP specifically - these would clarify mission-side budgets but should be reported as mission instrument participation, not personal funding.
